title: WASM scoring/validation interface
description: Interface for game-specific WASM modules (Tier 2). Defines the API contract: is_legal(state, move) → bool, score(state) → scores, apply_effect(state, trigger) → state. Used for Carcassonne field scoring, Go territory, etc.
close_reason: GameExtension trait with is_legal, legal_moves, apply_effect, score, check_end. NoExtension default. PlayerScore and EndCheckResult types.
